title: Wasm Fastmath Number Fields V2
objective: Profile cubic maximal order, ideal, zeta, class, unit, and order workflows; close the highest-impact normal-case portable hot loop through source-transparent number-field kernels with canonical proof semantics and direct-Wasm route evidence

oracles: direct generated FLINT Wasm Round-2 primitive

handoff.summary: Normal public cubic maximal-order construction now converts an unavailable compact order resource into one batched generated FLINT Round-2 call for every certified word prime, while preserving exact dynamic fallback and independent maximality certification through a fresh generated replay. The public, direct-generated, and forced-disabled routes agree on exact bases, discriminants, indices, and certificates. The exact production artifact sha256:48a32bf416f0e56519e003f51e3a3aa087d55616a50d95e17f3efb0382aed436 passes the two focused Node-Wasm tests and 37 existing number-field regressions. For the representative cubic index-two workload, the public route measured 61.51 ms warm median versus 208.24 ms with the primitive disabled (3.38x), with 61 versus 354 crossings and 760 versus 12,815 copied bytes. Dedekind-zeta factor-degree batching and source-transparent coefficient assembly were already direct Wasm and required no duplicate implementation.
risks: The compact number_field_order_from_polynomial_resource and authenticated carried-analysis resources remain unavailable in Wasm; the public route deliberately composes the existing lower-level generated Round-2 primitive and independently replays it for certification.

The explicit algorithm='round2' selector and exceptional arbitrary primes above the word-prime ceiling retain the exact portable implementation; this change accelerates the normal auto/native word-prime route only.

The number-field-algorithms lazy package is 1,119,968 of 1,120,000 bytes. Concurrent number-field integration may require a reviewed package split or budget adjustment rather than further local compression.
Runtime receipts in this lane are Linux x64. Other required hosts consume the existing generated FLINT capability or its tested exact fallback and remain integration-CI responsibilities.

The lane-local aggregate pnpm test:native was stopped at coordinator request after the coherent root build and native FLINT suites passed; the coordinator reports the aggregate checks green on the integrated source. The focused exact-artifact and number-field receipts here are current, but the integrated contract owner must attach the aggregate receipt before advancing this task to review.
next_steps: Port the variable-size compact order and authenticated field-analysis resource ownership to Wasm so construction and terminal proof can share one packed resource without the independent replay call.
Decide whether forced algorithm='round2' should select the generated batch when available; retain an explicit way to exercise the dynamic differential oracle.
Profile and close the separate class-group, unit-group, and ideal-arithmetic workflows in their existing claimed lanes; do not duplicate the already-direct zeta factor and coefficient kernels.
Keep arbitrary-prime polygon/Buchmann-Lenstra paths exact and portable unless a mature arbitrary-modulus library route is added with its own certificates.
